connectivity_convention: B is covalently bonded to two phenyl ipso carbons and to quinolinolate N and O; the ligand is deprotonated at O. The ring uses standard 8-hydroxyquinoline numbering (N=1, C2 adjacent to N, O at C8).

environment.default: isolated monomer with implicit toluene solvent

aggregate.definition: two BQ7 molecules in a stacked arrangement, with starting geometry and selection rationale supplied by the agent
